News & tips, & F&O Quotes, NSE/BSE Forecast News and Live Quotes}} | operating_income = {{up}} {{INRConvert|1623|c}} (2024) | net_income = {{up}} {{INRConvert|435|c}} (2024) | assets = {{up}} {{INRConvert|36756|c}} (2024) | equity = {{up}} {{INRConvert|23114|c}} (2024) | owner = | parent = [[Tata Group]] | divisions = | subsidiaries = {{Plainlist| *[[Tata Chemicals Europe]] *[[British Salt]] *[[Tata Swach]] *[[Magadi Soda Company]] *Rallis India}} | website = {{URL|http://www.tatachemicals.com/}} | footnotes = }} '''Tata Chemicals Limited''' is an Indian [[multinational corporation]] with interests in [[chemical]]s, crop protection and specialty chemistry products.{{cite web |author=Br Natarajan |url=http://www.indiaprwire.com/pressrelease/education/200802027097.htm |title=BITS Pilani and Tata Chemicals Join Hands for HRD |publisher=Indiaprwire.com |access-date=16 July 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721132405/http://www.indiaprwire.com/pressrelease/education/200802027097.htm |archive-date=21 July 2011 |url-status=dead }} The company is headquartered in [[Mumbai]] and has operations across India, Europe, North America and Africa. Tata Chemicals is a part of the [[Tata Group]] and its shares are traded on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]].{{cite web|url=http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/snapshot/snapshot_article.asp?ticker=878472&page=0 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121003104029/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/snapshot/snapshot_article.asp?ticker=878472&page=0 |url-status=dead |archive-date=3 October 2012 |title=Tata Chemicals Ltd. (878472): Company Description – BusinessWeek |publisher=Investing.businessweek.com |date=24 May 2010 |access-date=16 July 2010}} Tata Chemicals has a publicly listed subsidiary called Rallis India.{{Cite web |title=About Rallis India Limited |url=https://www.rallis.com/about-us |access-date=2022-04-18 |website=rallis.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Rallis India History {{!}} Rallis India Information |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/rallis-india-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13204.cms |access-date=2022-04-18 |website=The Economic Times |language=en}} == History and operations == Tata Chemicals has the third largest [[soda ash]] production capacity plant in India. This was the second soda ash plant built in India by Kapilram Vakil (grandson of late Indian justice [[Nanabhai Haridas]]) that started operating in the year 1944.{{cite web |url=http://www.tata.in/aboutus/articlesinside/Chemicals-with-a-capital-sea |title=Chemicals with a capital sea |publisher=Tata.in |date=1 April 2004 |access-date=4 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160809011427/http://www.tata.in/aboutus/articlesinside/Chemicals-with-a-capital-sea |archive-date=9 August 2016 |url-status=dead }} The township Mithapur, derives its name from "Mitha" which means salt in Gujarati language. Since 2006, Tata Chemicals has owned [[Brunner Mond]], a United Kingdom-based chemical company with operations in [[Magadi, Kenya|Magadi]] (Kenya). On 27 March 2008, Tata Chemicals Ltd acquired General Chemical of US.{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2008/02/01/stories/2008020152550100.htm |title=Tatas acquire General Chemical of US for $1 b |work=Business Line|date=1 February 2008 |access-date=16 July 2010}}{{cite web|url=https://www.dholerametrocity.com/News-Tata-plans-to-invest-in-lithium-ion-battery-manufacturing-in-Gujarat.php |title=Tata plans to invest in lithium ion battery manufacturing in Gujarat |work=Business Line|date=18 January 2019 |access-date=16 July 2019}} In April 2010, Tata Chemicals acquired 25% stake in ammonia-urea fertilizer complex in Gabon for {{USD}}290 million.{{cite web|url=http://www.livemint.com/2011/04/11191454/TCL-buys-25-stake-in-urea-com.html?h=B |title=TCL buys 25% stake in urea complex in Africa for $290 mn |date=11 April 2010 }} The first phase of the plant will have a full operational capacity of 2.2 billion tons of ammonia and 3.85 billion tons of urea per day. In 2016, Tata Chemicals sold its urea business to Pune-based Yara India, part of the Norwegian chemical company, [[Yara International]].{{Cite news |last=ET Bureau |date=11 August 2016 |title=Tata Group sells Urea business to Pune-based Yara Fertilizers India |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/chem-/-fertilisers/tata-group-sells-urea-business-to-pune-based-yara-fertilizers-india/articleshow/53630223.cms |access-date=2022-06-13}} In 2019, Tata Group transferred Tata Chemicals' branded food business to [[Tata Global Beverages]] (now [[Tata Consumer Products]]), in an all-share deal.{{Cite web |last=PTI |date=2019-05-15 |title=Tata Group to consolidate FMCG Business; announces Tata Chemicals transfer to Tata Global Beverages |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/tata-group-tata-chemicals-transfer-to-tata-global-beverages-business-196575-2019-05-15 |access-date=2022-06-14 |website=Business Today |language=en}} In 2022, Tata Chemicals, through its subsidiary [[Tata Chemicals Europe]], set up the UK's first industrial-scale carbon capture and usage plant.{{Cite web |last=Livemint |date=2022-06-24 |title=Tata Chemicals Europe opens UK's largest carbon capture plant |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/tata-chemicals-europe-opens-uk-s-largest-carbon-capture-plant-worth-20-million-euros-11656063978768.html |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=mint |language=en}} The plant can capture 40,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide per annum. ==Research and Development Center== The Research and Development Center Tata Chemicals Innovation Center located at [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]] started operations in 2004. The team of scientists is working in the following areas: Food Science & Technology, Advanced Materials, Green Chemistry.{{cite news |last= John|first= Satish|date= 8 September 2009|title= Tata Chemicals working on a green makeover|url= https://www.livemint.com/Companies/7GDdow76nELdfmCb5RTXJK/Tata-Chemicals-working-on-a-green-makeover.html|work= [[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]}} == Rallis India == Rallis India is a subsidiary of Tata Chemicals, and is listed on both the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] and the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]]. Rallis India operates in the agriculture sector and has an India focused business, an international focused business, and a seeds business.{{Cite web |title=Rallis : Business Review |url=https://www.rallis.com/dar-2020-21/business-review.php |access-date=2022-04-21 |website=www.rallis.com}} Both the India and international businesses focus on crop nutrition and crop protection products.{{Cite web |date=2021 |title=Rallis Annual Report 2020-2021 |url=https://www.rallis.com/dar-2020-21/pdf/Rallis-Annual-Report-2021.pdf |access-date=22 April 2022 |website=Rallis.com |page=2 |format=PDF}} The international business also offers [[active ingredient]]s, formulations and [[Contract manufacturing organization|contract manufacturing]] services. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{official website|http://www.tatachemicals.com/}} {{Tata Group}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Tata Chemicals| ]] [[Category:Tata Sons subsidiaries]] [[Category:Chemical companies of India]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 1939]] [[Category:1939 establishments in British India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Tata Group]]
extract: Tata Chemicals Limited is an Indian multinational corporation with interests in chemicals, crop protection and specialty chemistry products. The company is headquartered in Mumbai and has operations across India, Europe, North America and Africa. Tata Chemicals is a part of the Tata Group and its shares are traded on the NSE and BSE. Tata Chemicals has a publicly listed subsidiary called Rallis India.
